name: City Council Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 25, 2024 - 6:30 p.m.

 ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
 Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting through
 Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors open 30
 minutes before the meeting start time.

 PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
 Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or may
 submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
 Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
 are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
 management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
 the presiding officer.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than 4:00
 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the meeting
 and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
 Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
 agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments, see
 Public Comments/Speakers section.

 2939375.2
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Pearl, Halpern, McSweeney, Mayor Pro Tem
  Honig, Mayor Davis

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of September 11, 2024 City Council Study Session and Regular Session Meeting.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS: None

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s subject
matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the presiding
officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written comment, see
Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called to speak while in
the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

2939375.2
 MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Library Report

4.  Chamber of Commerce Quarterly Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: NONE

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 09-006; RESOLUTION NO. 2365-24 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2365-24, determining Modification No. 1 of Conditional Use Permit
  No. 09-006 is exempt from CEQA and authorizing the sale of alcohol for offsite
  consumption in conjunction with the operation of an existing Yacht Club located at
  32119 Lindero Canyon Road.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2365-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 1 OF CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT NO. 09-006 TO AUTHORIZE THE ONGOING CLUB ACTIVITIES AND
  CONTINUED SALE OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES FOR ON-SITE CONSUMPTION AT
  THE WESTLAKE YACHT CLUB LOCATED AT 32119 RUSSELL RANCH ROAD

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will be
no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the Consent
Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS:  Warrants effective September 15, 2024 in the
  amount of $960,859.78.

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  BIENNIAL REVIEW AND UPDATE OF THE CITY’S CONFLICT OF
  INTEREST CODE; RESOLUTION NO. 2366-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2366-
  24, adopting an updated Conflict of Interest Code for the City and repealing
  Resolution No. 2273-22.

2939375.2
   RESOLUTION NO. 2366-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE ADOPTING AN UPDATED CONFLICT OF
  INTEREST CODE AND REPEALING RESOLUTION NO. 2273-22

  2.  ACCEPTANCE OF BUS SHELTER IMPROVEMENT PROJECT, PHASE II;
  FILE NOTICE OF COMPLETION - Accept the Bus Shelter Improvement
  Project and authorize the City Clerk to execute and record a “Notice of
  Completion” on behalf of the City.

  3.  APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING PROGRESS PAYMENTS
  TO J&H ENGINEERING GENERAL CONTRACTORS, INC.; RESOLUTION
  NO. 2367-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2367-24.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2367-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AUTHORIZING PROGRESS PAYMENTS TO J &
  H ENGINEERING GENERAL CONTRACTORS, INC.

OLD BUSINESS: None

NEW BUSINESS:

  1. AUTHORIZING SUBMITTAL OF APPLICATION FOR PROPOSITION 68 PER
  CAPITA GRANT FUNDS FOR REPLACEMENT PLAYGROUND EQUIPMENT
  AND RESTROOM RENOVATION AT BERNIECE BENNETT PARK;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2368-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2368-24, authorizing submittal
  of an application for Proposition 68 Per Capita grant funds for replacement
  playground equipment and restroom renovation at Berniece Bennett Park.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2368-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING APPLICATION(S) FOR PER CAPITA GRANT
  FUNDS

  2. ADJUSTMENT OF MEDICAL PREMIUM RATES AND EMPLOYER
  CONTRIBUTIONS FOR ACTIVE AND RETIRED EMPLOYEES EFFECTIVE
  JANUARY 1, 2025; RESOLUTION 2369-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2369-24,
  Amending Resolution No. 1564-11 to Increase the Insurance Coverage Benefit for
  Full-Time Active and Retired Employees.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2369-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 1564-11 TO INCREASE THE
  INSURANCE COVERAGE BENEFIT FOR FULL-TIME ACTIVE AND RETIRED
  EMPLOYEES
